evaluation_policy.single_image_rule: Every chosen-candidate gate must pass in the same saved image; evidence cannot be combined across attempts.

gates.observable_requirement: The same frame clearly shows a civilian 1960s rocket-service gantry with bold rounded or streamlined curves and operating power or radiation meters integrated into its structure; cheerful space-age architecture and hazardous reactor instrumentation must both be unmistakable.

One thick shielded power umbilical visibly connects the chrome seed-vault to a finned floor socket, with its exposed connector bank, two analog load gauges, and clear dosimetry window each separately legible.

One open shielded diagnostic drawer visibly presents a cobalt sample beneath a needle-style detector and a side-by-side pair of analog dials that read as dose-versus-power comparison hardware; drawer, sample, detector, and both dials must all be readable.

A worn turquoise service cart beside the robot visibly separates replacement and returned hardware: a coiled replacement sensor and scuffed shield collar sit on the work surface, while a physically tagged spent umbilical rests in a distinct return tray.
